messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered — Severity 2 — Multiple APAC->US requests failing to route (latency spikes and 502s). Affected route: /generate. Time: 2026-03-15T08:20:34Z

 eve_oncall: I'm on it. seeing spike in 502s ~08:19 UTC across apac->us hops. ETA triage 5m

 sam-net: grabbing routing logs. suspect steering policy oscillation, dns ttl churn. will paste snippets in a sec

 maria-sre: can you dump steer metrics? `curl -s http://telemetry/steer?range=5m` — also check dns cache TTL on edge and region-pin controller logs

 sam-net: paste logs:
```
2026-03-15T08:18:54Z route-eval: probe=apac->us score_delta=+0.12 -> redirect
2026-03-15T08:19:00Z route-eval: probe=apac->us score_delta=-0.09 -> pin
2026-03-15T08:19:12Z dns: cache flush due to negative TTL
2026-03-15T08:19:20Z route-eval: probe=apac->us score_delta=+0.15 -> redirect
```

 tyler-eng: looks like a classic feedback loop between steer and pin controller. pin cooldown is 5s, steer window 15s -> flips too fast

 eve_oncall: customer impact: support queue shows ~12 reports of request timeouts from APAC tenants. top affected: AcmeCorp (high priority), NovaApps (medium). marking both on the incident board

 jane-support: flagged AcmeCorp case INC-3245, they reported "service interruptions for ~30s". Drafting a short proactive note to send.

 maria-sre: mitigation options (ranked):
  1) increase pin cooldown to 60s (hotpatch controller) — cheap and quick
  2) bump DNS min-ttl to 120s at edge to dampen rapid rebinds
  3) temporary static fallback for APAC->US to a stable region (last resort)

 sam-net: recommend immediate: apply (1) + (2) and disable auto-steer for APAC->US for 5m to let caches settle

 tyler-eng: to hotpatch pin cooldown (command ready):
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/region-pin-controller PIN_COOLDOWN=60
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/region-pin-controller
```

 eve_oncall: running the hotpatch now. tagging @ops-bot to orchestrate rollout and watch progress

 ops-bot: Command acknowledged. Starting rolling restart of deployment/region-pin-controller across prod clusters. Monitoring hooks enabled.

 maria-sre: monitoring dashboards: tailing steer_signal, route_pins, dns_misses. latency and 502s trending down already (~18s after rollout start).

 sam-net: also pushed DNS edge policy change: set min-ttl=120s for route binding. Propagation expected within ~30s.

 eve_oncall: customer comms: sent initial note to AcmeCorp & NovaApps — internal routing detected, mitigation applied, we'll follow up with root cause in 24-48h. :thumbsup:

 tyler-eng: follow-up engineering actions: add a circuit-breaker in steering that detects oscillation (flip count > 3 in 1m) and disables auto-steer, increase default pin cooldown, and add synthetic probe that alerts sooner

 maria-sre: assigning postmortem owner: @maria-sre. Please capture timeline, metrics, and action items.

 incident-bot: Incident RESOLVED at 2026-03-15T08:22:58Z — Routing oscillation mitigated via controller cooldown and DNS TTL increase. PagerDuty incident closed.

 eve_oncall: closing thread after stable baseline held for 5m. Great response, team. Will follow up with postmortem doc and customer RCA.
